title: The Quiet Yes You Already Felt
core_idea: Intuition often speaks first and quietly, before the mind builds its arguments; learning to notice that first response.
text: There is often a moment, just before you start explaining things to yourself, when part of you already knows. A quiet yes. A soft no. Then the reasoning arrives and talks over it. Many people describe intuition this way: not as a loud voice, but as a first response that comes before the arguments. You don't have to obey every hunch. But you can begin to notice it. Next time you face a choice, pause for one breath and ask what you felt before you started thinking. Write it down if it helps. Over time, you may discover that this quiet first answer has been trying to guide you for years.
description: A short reflection on intuition as the quiet first response that comes before our reasoning, and how to start noticing it.
